# MIGRATION CHECKLIST
# Sources      : 2 — SEQ_FILE_WAREHOUSE_STOCK, DB2_SRC_ERP_INVENTORY
# Joins        : 1 — JOIN_WAREHOUSE_ERP : LeftOuter
# Branches     : 2 — JOIN_WAREHOUSE_ERP (Branch 0 to TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY, Branch 1 to EXCEPTION_UNMATCHED), TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY (Branch 0 to SORT_BY_ITEM)
# Computed cols: AVAILABLE_QTY, INVENTORY_VALUE, STOCK_STATUS, REORDER_REQUIRED, DAYS_UNTIL_REORDER, RECORD_HASH, SCD_EFF_START_DATE, SCD_EFF_END_DATE, IS_CURRENT_FLAG
# Sinks        : 2 — BQ_TGT_INVENTORY_DIM, SEQ_FILE_EXCEPTIONS
# Exceptions   : yes — SEQ_FILE_EXCEPTIONS

import os
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

# Initialize Spark Session with configuration parameters
spark = (
    SparkSession.builder
    .appName("JOB_INVENTORY_RECONCILIATION")
    .config("spark.sql.adaptive.enabled", "true")
    .config("spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions", "true")
    .getOrCreate()
)

# ── Source: DB2_SRC_ERP_INVENTORY
db2_url = os.environ.get("ERP_DB2_PROD_URL", "jdbc:db2://localhost:50000/ERPDB")
db2_user = os.environ.get("ERP_DB2_PROD_USER", "db2user")
db2_password = os.environ.get("ERP_DB2_PROD_PASSWORD", "")
db2_query = "SELECT ITEM_CODE, ITEM_DESC, CATEGORY, SUPPLIER_ID, REORDER_LEVEL, LEAD_TIME_DAYS, IS_ACTIVE, EFF_START_DATE, EFF_END_DATE FROM ERP.ITEM_MASTER WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'"

df_db2_src_erp_inventory = (
    spark.read
    .format("jdbc")
    .option("url", db2_url)
    .option("user", db2_user)
    .option("password", db2_password)
    .option("query", db2_query)
    .load()
)

# ── Source: SEQ_FILE_WAREHOUSE_STOCK
ds_rundate = os.environ.get("DS_RUNDATE", "default_date")
warehouse_stock_path = os.environ.get(
    "SEQ_FILE_WAREHOUSE_STOCK_PATH",
    f"/data/warehouse/stock_snapshot_{ds_rundate}.csv"
)

df_seq_file_warehouse_stock = (
    spark.read
    .format("csv")
    .option("header", "true")
    .option("inferSchema", "true")
    .option("delimiter", ",")
    .load(warehouse_stock_path)
)

# ── Stage: LOOKUP_SUPPLIER_INFO
# Since this represents a supplier information lookup reference dataset, we broadcast it
supplier_ref_path = os.environ.get("SUPPLIER_REF_PATH", "/data/reference/supplier_info.csv")
df_supplier_ref = (
    spark.read
    .format("csv")
    .option("header", "true")
    .option("inferSchema", "true")
    .load(supplier_ref_path)
)

# Perform join on SUPPLIER_ID with continue-on-no-match (left join)
df_lookup_supplier_info = (
    df_db2_src_erp_inventory.join(
        F.broadcast(df_supplier_ref),
        on="SUPPLIER_ID",
        how="left"
    )
)

# ── Stage: JOIN_WAREHOUSE_ERP
# Match records flow to main branch, unmatched warehouse records flow to exception branch
df_join_warehouse_erp = (
    df_seq_file_warehouse_stock.join(
        df_lookup_supplier_info,
        on="ITEM_CODE",
        how="left"
    )
)

# ── Branch 1 (unmatched/exception) → EXCEPTION_UNMATCHED
df_exception_unmatched = (
    df_seq_file_warehouse_stock.join(
        df_lookup_supplier_info,
        on="ITEM_CODE",
        how="left_anti"
    )
)

exceptions_path = os.environ.get(
    "SEQ_FILE_EXCEPTIONS_PATH",
    f"/data/exceptions/inventory_exceptions_{ds_rundate}.csv"
)

df_exception_unmatched.write.format("csv").option("header", "true").mode("overwrite").save(exceptions_path)

# ── Stage: TRANSFORM_SCD2_INVENTORY
# Compute new metrics and slowly changing dimension Type 2 window columns
scd_window = Window.partitionBy("ITEM_CODE").orderBy("SCD_EFF_START_DATE")

df_transform_scd2_inventory = (
    df_join_warehouse_erp
    .withColumn("AVAILABLE_QTY", F.coalesce(F.col("ON_HAND_QTY"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("RESERVED_QTY"), F.lit(0)))
    .withColumn("INVENTORY_VALUE", F.coalesce(F.col("ON_HAND_QTY"), F.lit(0)) * F.coalesce(F.col("UNIT_COST"), F.lit(0.0)))
    .withColumn(
        "STOCK_STATUS",
        F.when(F.col("AVAILABLE_QTY") == 0, F.lit("OUT_OF_STOCK"))
        .when(F.col("AVAILABLE_QTY") < F.col("REORDER_LEVEL"), F.lit("LOW_STOCK"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("IN_STOCK"))
    )
    .withColumn("REORDER_REQUIRED", F.when(F.col("AVAILABLE_QTY") < F.col("REORDER_LEVEL"), F.lit(1)).otherwise(F.lit(0)))
    .withColumn("DAYS_UNTIL_REORDER", F.when(F.col("REORDER_REQUIRED") == 1, F.col("LEAD_TIME_DAYS")).otherwise(F.lit(-1)))
    .withColumn("RECORD_HASH", F.sha2(F.concat_ws("|", "ITEM_CODE", "WAREHOUSE_ID", "ON_HAND_QTY", "UNIT_COST"), 256))
    .withColumn("SCD_EFF_START_DATE", F.current_date())
    .withColumn(
        "SCD_EFF_END_DATE",
        F.coalesce(
            F.lead("SCD_EFF_START_DATE").over(scd_window),
            F.lit("9999-12-31").cast("date")
        )
    )
    .withColumn(
        "IS_CURRENT_FLAG",
        F.when(F.col("SCD_EFF_END_DATE") == F.lit("9999-12-31").cast("date"), F.lit(1)).otherwise(F.lit(0))
    )
)

# ── Stage: SORT_BY_ITEM
df_sort_by_item = df_transform_scd2_inventory.orderBy("ITEM_CODE", "WAREHOUSE_ID")

# ── Target: BQ_TGT_INVENTORY_DIM
bq_project = os.environ.get("BQ_PROJECT_ID", "acme-analytics-prod")
bq_dataset = os.environ.get("BQ_DATASET", "supply_chain")
bq_table = f"{bq_project}.{bq_dataset}.inventory_dimension"

df_sort_by_item.write.format("bigquery").option("table", bq_table).option("parentProject", bq_project).mode("append").save()

# Stop spark session
spark.stop()

import pytest
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, StringType, IntegerType, DoubleType, DateType
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def spark():
    return (
        SparkSession.builder
        .master("local[*]")
        .appName("pytest-pyspark-job-reconciliation")
        .config("spark.sql.adaptive.enabled", "false")
        .getOrCreate()
    )

def test_available_qty(spark):
    schema = StructType([
        StructField("ON_HAND_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
        StructField("RESERVED_QTY", IntegerType(), True)
    ])
    data = [(10, 2), (5, 5), (0, 0), (None, None)]
    df = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
    
    res = df.withColumn("AVAILABLE_QTY", F.coalesce(F.col("ON_HAND_QTY"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("RESERVED_QTY"), F.lit(0))).collect()
    
    assert res[0]["AVAILABLE_QTY"] == 8
    assert res[1]["AVAILABLE_QTY"] == 0
    assert res[2]["AVAILABLE_QTY"] == 0
    assert res[3]["AVAILABLE_QTY"] == 0

def test_inventory_value(spark):
    schema = StructType([
        StructField("ON_HAND_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
        StructField("UNIT_COST", DoubleType(), True)
    ])
    data = [(10, 1.5), (0, 10.0), (None, None)]
    df = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
    
    res = df.withColumn("INVENTORY_VALUE", F.coalesce(F.col("ON_HAND_QTY"), F.lit(0)) * F.coalesce(F.col("UNIT_COST"), F.lit(0.0))).collect()
    
    assert res[0]["INVENTORY_VALUE"] == 15.0
    assert res[1]["INVENTORY_VALUE"] == 0.0
    assert res[2]["INVENTORY_VALUE"] == 0.0

def test_stock_status_and_reorder(spark):
    schema = StructType([
        StructField("AVAILABLE_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
        StructField("REORDER_LEVEL", IntegerType(), True),
        StructField("LEAD_TIME_DAYS", IntegerType(), True)
    ])
    data = [
        (0, 5, 2),
        (3, 5, 3),
        (10, 5, 4)
    ]
    df = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
    
    res = (
        df.withColumn(
            "STOCK_STATUS",
            F.when(F.col("AVAILABLE_QTY") == 0, F.lit("OUT_OF_STOCK"))
            .when(F.col("AVAILABLE_QTY") < F.col("REORDER_LEVEL"), F.lit("LOW_STOCK"))
            .otherwise(F.lit("IN_STOCK"))
        )
        .withColumn("REORDER_REQUIRED", F.when(F.col("AVAILABLE_QTY") < F.col("REORDER_LEVEL"), F.lit(1)).otherwise(F.lit(0)))
        .withColumn("DAYS_UNTIL_REORDER", F.when(F.col("REORDER_REQUIRED") == 1, F.col("LEAD_TIME_DAYS")).otherwise(F.lit(-1)))
    ).collect()
    
    assert res[0]["STOCK_STATUS"] == "OUT_OF_STOCK"
    assert res[0]["REORDER_REQUIRED"] == 1
    assert res[0]["DAYS_UNTIL_REORDER"] == 2
    
    assert res[1]["STOCK_STATUS"] == "LOW_STOCK"
    assert res[1]["REORDER_REQUIRED"] == 1
    assert res[1]["DAYS_UNTIL_REORDER"] == 3
    
    assert res[2]["STOCK_STATUS"] == "IN_STOCK"
    assert res[2]["REORDER_REQUIRED"] == 0
    assert res[2]["DAYS_UNTIL_REORDER"] == -1

def test_record_hash(spark):
    schema = StructType([
        StructField("ITEM_CODE", StringType(), True),
        StructField("WAREHOUSE_ID", StringType(), True),
        StructField("ON_HAND_QTY", IntegerType(), True),
        StructField("UNIT_COST", DoubleType(), True)
    ])
    data = [("A01", "W01", 10, 1.5)]
    df = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
    
    res = df.withColumn("RECORD_HASH", F.sha2(F.concat_ws("|", "ITEM_CODE", "WAREHOUSE_ID", "ON_HAND_QTY", "UNIT_COST"), 256)).collect()
    assert len(res[0]["RECORD_HASH"]) == 64

def test_scd2_logic(spark):
    schema = StructType([
        StructField("ITEM_CODE", StringType(), True),
        StructField("SCD_EFF_START_DATE", StringType(), True)
    ])
    data = [
        ("ITEM_A", "2026-01-01"),
        ("ITEM_A", "2026-02-01"),
        ("ITEM_B", "2026-01-15")
    ]
    df = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema)
    
    # Cast strings to dates for checking
    df = df.withColumn("SCD_EFF_START_DATE", F.col("SCD_EFF_START_DATE").cast("date"))
    
    scd_window = Window.partitionBy("ITEM_CODE").orderBy("SCD_EFF_START_DATE")
    res = (
        df.withColumn(
            "SCD_EFF_END_DATE",
            F.coalesce(
                F.lead("SCD_EFF_START_DATE").over(scd_window),
                F.lit("9999-12-31").cast("date")
            )
        )
        .withColumn(
            "IS_CURRENT_FLAG",
            F.when(F.col("SCD_EFF_END_DATE") == F.lit("9999-12-31").cast("date"), F.lit(1)).otherwise(F.lit(0))
        )
        .orderBy("ITEM_CODE", "SCD_EFF_START_DATE")
    ).collect()
    
    assert str(res[0]["SCD_EFF_END_DATE"]) == "2026-02-01"
    assert res[0]["IS_CURRENT_FLAG"] == 0
    
    assert str(res[1]["SCD_EFF_END_DATE"]) == "9999-12-31"
    assert res[1]["IS_CURRENT_FLAG"] == 1
    
    assert str(res[2]["SCD_EFF_END_DATE"]) == "9999-12-31"
    assert res[2]["IS_CURRENT_FLAG"] == 1
